rationale: The mission brief's pre-mission checklist lists a CO2 meter (with a VOC/TVOC meter and spare batteries) in the air quality monitoring kit to source. Crew 15 was already measuring CO2, which rose sharply overnight on the upper floor every night; the register lesson (CO2 monitoring from Day 1, before the first night) concerns timing and ventilation, and the meter itself is the brief author's checklist item.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part I §1.3 Pre-mission checklist, line 78 (air quality monitoring kit: 'CO2 meter'); context: Part IV §4.4 Scientific incidents, lines 689-694
